request.notes: Replaces r5-slots-001 (cancelled before it started: its cap of $5.30 could not cover the only offer in stock, H200 at $5.55/h, for max_hours + 0.25 h). Same code and sizes; max_hours 0.65 and cap $5.00 cover H200 (5.55 x 0.9 = $5.00). Pilot before the full job (study cap $20 in total). Checks GPU memory, step time, training stability and the whole pipeline (float64 simulation with the tracker re-run for label maps, float32 slot encoders trained 4 replicas at once by truncated BPTT with persistent slot memory, CPU certification workers) at reduced size. Device data are passed to jitted functions as arguments; compiled functions are released between configs. No network or subprocess use outside setup. Training stops starting configs 19 min after job start, certification 26 min. CPU test passed: job.sh end to end at tiny size from a git archive of exactly these paths.
request.purpose: Round-5 study slots (track 1), pilot: slot encoders with memory on raw gliders level 0 (soft k-means, learned geometric slot attention with moment / code readout; closure, reconstruction, supervised capacity control), reduced size: 48 trajectories per half, 600 steps, 6 configs
request.setup:
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH
uv venv -q -p 3.12 $GPUJOB_DIR/.venv && . $GPUJOB_DIR/.venv/bin/activate
uv pip install -q 'jax[cuda12]==0.12.0.1' numpy==2.5.4 scipy==1.18.0
